summary: The Windows x64 release was published after replacing GitVerse create-release's 10-second API call with a PowerShell 5-compatible publisher that retries transport errors and verifies the attached archive.

checks.name: Windows release workflow
checks.observation: GitVerse run 1684338 passed source checkout, Flutter version check, locked dependency resolution, Flutter tests, analysis, Windows release build, archive packaging, and publication.

checks.name: Release and attachment record
checks.observation: The GitVerse release API returned tag windows-v1.0.13 at source revision 96ccceed77313db405e81a6530fe96bad052674a, public non-draft release ID 548822659, and one attachment BOOHTACORD-windows-v1.0.13-x64.zip (24,109,338 bytes). The release page returned HTTP 200.

checks.name: Local Windows x64 archive
checks.observation: A separate local build produced BOOHTACORD-windows-v1.0.13-x64.zip (24,708,054 bytes; SHA-256 114675C96A1E217003D104BF7FECEA2E23838B4CB77B930C2913D2D1513282E9). The published archive was rebuilt by GitVerse and has a different size.

checks.name: Live two-client screen metrics and unauthenticated asset download
checks.observation: No live two-client session was available. A direct unauthenticated HEAD request to the attachment endpoint returned 403, so browser download was not independently verified outside the GitVerse release page.

remaining: Verify the archive download from a browser and screen-share sender/receiver metrics in a two-client Windows session.
